news.contents: Los Angeles Chargers running back Omarion Hampton finally produced as the fantasy running back everyone had hoped he would be last week. The young back turned 22 carries for a season-high 105 rushing yards and scored a touchdown. He finished Week 10 with 17.5 PPR points and was the RB13 in scoring. news.contents: New York Jets wide receiver Garrett Wilson returned from a concussion against Buffalo and played 67 of 71 offensive snaps, catching seven of 14 targets for 106 yards. Geno Smith hit him for 33 yards in the second quarter, and Cade Klubnik found him for 29 in the third. Wilson drew five targets in the first half and nine in the second, staying involved through the quarterback changes.
